tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search the kosher gift catalogue. Budget, stock and shipping filters are applied as hard constraints before ranking, so nothing above max_price is ever returned. Returns an empty result with an explanation rather than a nearest-miss when nothing matches.

tools.name: get_gift
tools.description: Full detail for one product by id or slug, plus any other listing of the same physical item (the catalogue carries occasion-specific listings of the same basket) so it is offered once, not twice.

tools.name: list_occasions
tools.description: The occasion keys search_gifts accepts, with how many gifts each has. Derived from the products themselves, so it never offers a filter that would return nothing.

tools.name: compare_gifts
tools.description: Side-by-side detail for 2 to 5 products, for choosing between them.

tools.name: recommend_gifts
tools.description: A short ranked shortlist for an occasion and budget. Each entry carries the reason, built only from facts on the product. The shop holds no ratings or reviews, so none are returned.

tools.name: check_delivery
tools.description: Whether a product can reach a destination and the earliest date it can honestly arrive. Orders by 10am ET on a business day ship that day and transit is 1-5 business days by zone, so the soonest arrival is about three days out — never tomorrow.

tools.name: get_shop_policies
tools.description: Kosher certification wording, dispatch and transit times, shipping cost, sales tax, policy links, and what this server can and cannot do about payment. Read this before telling a customer anything about certification or delivery.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Server-side totals for a cart: merchandise, shipping, sales tax and the grand total. Prices come from the database, never from the caller. Indicative only — checkout recomputes every figure at payment and that is what is charged. Discount codes are not evaluated here.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for a cart and a recipient. THIS DOES NOT CHARGE ANYTHING. It returns a URL that a person opens and pays on Stripe; nothing is charged until they do, and this server never sees card details. Confirm the items, the recipient address and the total with the customer BEFORE

tools.name: quote_trees
tools.description: Price for N trees planted in Israel with one dedication certificate, and the optional printed, mailed copy ($5). Prices come from the live shop. Trees are not taxed.

tools.name: create_tree_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for N trees planted in Israel with a personalised Certificate of Dedication. THIS DOES NOT CHARGE ANYTHING: a person opens the link and pays. After payment the certificate is emailed within minutes to the buyer and, if given, the family; a printed copy is mailed if prin

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status and tracking for ONE order. Both the order number and the email the order was placed with are required, and both must match — a token alone cannot look up an order. Returns the same answer for "no such order" and "not your order", so order numbers cannot be probed. Never returns the street ad

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_checkout_link" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a Stripe Checkout link for a cart and a recipient. THIS DOES NOT CHARGE ANYTHING. It returns a URL that a person opens and pays on Stripe; nothing is cha…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order_status · Private data: quote_order, get_order_status · Public sink: get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order_status · Private data: quote_order, get_order_status · Public sink: get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
